description: This file defines interfaces and implementations for managing Kubernetes Namespace resources, including methods for create, update, delete, get, list, watch, patch, and apply operations within the client-go library.

classes.name: namespaces
classes.description: Implementation of the NamespaceInterface for managing Kubernetes Namespace resources.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status subresource of a Namespace.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists Namespace resources based on provided options.

methods.name: Watch
methods.description: Watches for changes to Namespace resources.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to a Namespace resource.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a declarative configuration to a Namespace.

methods.name: ApplyStatus
methods.description: Applies a declarative configuration to the status of a Namespace.

methods.name: newNamespaces
methods.description: Constructs a new namespaces client instance.
